lines.text: Two days later, in front of Enikk's door...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Two minutes remain until Sixo's attack is set to commence.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Is everyone prepared?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What's wrong, Anis? Are you scared?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I mean... given the circumstances...
Don't worry. We can do this.
As we exchange light conversation to calm our nerves, the two minutes pass quickly.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Sixo has begun.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: E2 Crystal attacks have been detected at four hundred and thirty locations across the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Expansion of the E2 Crystals has commenced.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: F-four hundred and thirty?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... She's really trying to put an end to everything.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Sh-shouldn't the power be going out by now?
The E2 Crystal attacks carried out across the Ark through Sixo's proxies have seemingly gone off without a hitch.
The many Sixos hear the sound of E2 Crystals expanding across the Ark, and they become certain of their victory.
Enikk will have to expend vast amounts of resources to contain the crisis.
Taking advantage of the weakened firewall, Sixo will attack Enikk and seize her authority.
Once she does, the Ark will belong entirely to her.
Filled with anticipation, Sixo moves toward Enikk's direction via electrical lines.
All of the other Sixos scattered across the Ark begin to converge toward Enikk,
eventually merging into a single mass as they go.
Having expended her resources, Enikk won't last one minute against the attack from Sixo in her complete form.
Sixo charges ahead, certain of her victory.
But then...
the Ark shuts down.
Sixo assesses the situation immediately.
There is no electricity anywhere in the Ark.
Nowhere except for a location near Enikk's room.
Without any power to feed on, the E2 Crystals will have all shattered.
Sixo reaches her destination and confirms that Enikk has remained intact.
Hatred wells up within Sixo.
She despises Enikk for sacrificing the Ark to protect herself.
Sixo knows she doesn't stand a chance against a fully powered Enikk.
As unfortunate as it is, retreat is the prudent option.
Besides, she has as many puppets at her disposal as she needs, and just as many E2 Crystals.
She can attempt this again at any time.
On the other hand, shutting down the Ark was an extreme measure that cannot be repeated so easily.
It is only a matter of time. Victory is inevitable.
Still, Sixo is disappointed that such a carefully laid plan yielded nothing.
As she turns to leave, something catches her attention.
A rush of elation follows.
She's found something she's always wanted:
hardware powerful enough to hold her entire self.
She had always been forced to split herself between dozens of connected computers.
It was in such an absurd configuration that she had manipulate humans and Nikkes alike up until now.
However, now she'll no longer have to deal with such an uncomfortable setup.
She will finally have an actual body, something she's wanted for so long.
"Not so omnipotent after all, huh?" Sixo thinks to herself, delighting in Enikk's miscalculation.
She transfers her entire self into the powerful new hardware.
She rejoices once more at the sensation of having a tangible form.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Sixo has taken the bait.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She has taken control of Endless.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Counters, engage.
All units, prepare for combat.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: This won't take long with our overwhelming firepower.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Agh, I really didn't think we'd have to fight that thing again.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Allow me to express my gratitude.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You've created such a magnificent vessel for me,

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: and even opted to forego using a human brain in favor of AI.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Thanks to that, I now possess the physical form I once only dreamed of.
Endless extends a hand, emitting a flash from her fingertips.
The light strikes the ground next to us,
leaving behind a clean-cut hole, as if carved out by a sharp blade.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Remarkable.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: The laser gets concentrated into a single point, allowing it to vaporize whatever it touches.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: At such a high temperature, there is theoretically nothing it cannot eradicate.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: And on top of that...
Endless floats up into the air.
She looks down at us.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: This body is capable of levitation as well.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I find myself at a loss as to what to do. The Counters hardly seem like they'd be a worthy opponent anymore.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: It may be strange for me to say this as an AI,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: but I have a hard time imagining the Counters losing.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: They are, after all, the strongest force in the Ark.
Endless dives toward us at high speed.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Then killing them will make me the strongest!

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: We will use Endless, a Nikke developed to keep the Outer Rim under control, as bait.
... A Nikke?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: One with an AI instead of a human brain.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She is a creation I am quite confident in. Sixo will no doubt be unable to resist possessing such a body.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What about Eternity?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Since your battle with her, Eternity has become increasingly self-aware.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She currently possesses a sense of self on par with that of a child.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... So you didn't want to use her because it'd feel like offing a kid?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I did not expect to arrive at such reasoning, but yes.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Endless, on the other hand, has not yet developed a self.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She is the most suitable to use as bait.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You said we would be the only ones fighting her,

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: but wouldn't it be better if we brought other Nikkes and all attacked her at once?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: It is clear that Sixo possesses data on every Nikke in the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That includes full specs and combat data.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Other Nikkes could potentially be compromised.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, the Commando Unit's full capabilities remain unknown to anyone in the Ark, myself included.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Rapi's body and weapon.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Anis's expansive armament Star.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Neon's new body.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: We have no reliable data for any of these.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Speaking strictly in terms of technical specifications, Endless is capable of defeating you.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: But if we consider your latent capabilities and combat experience,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I am certain you can subdue my masterpiece.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Firrre...powerrr!
A metallic whine fills the air,
as golden particles surge from Neon's weapon.
*Boom!*
Flames burst from the gun's muzzle, leaving a trail of golden particles in its wake.
A bullet flies toward the descending Endless.
She twists slightly to evade the shot,
but the ensuing shock wave makes her falter in midair.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: ... Where did that power come from?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wh-where did that firepower come from?!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Why're you acting so surprised?!
Anis aims her weapon at the faltering Endless.
*Bam, bam, bam*
Rounds looking like starlight blast forward.
Most miss, but one connects.
With a crisp ping, an explosion of light bursts forth and pushes Endless back.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: A laser weapon...? From Tetra?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Tetra developed a laser weapon...?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Why're you acting so surprised?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Focus. Both of you.
Rapi activates Seven Dwarves Zero's thruster and advances toward Endless, who has landed.
Anis follows close behind.
The drill roars to life and thrusts toward Endless.
The buzz of the drill tears through the air.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: A drill... with a magnetic field?
Endless raises both hands and blocks the spinning drill.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You might want to move your arms before they get shredded.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: If I do that, then it will be my torso that's shredded.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're not wrong there.
Endless moves one arm that was blocking the drill and opens her hand.
She points it at Rapi as it starts to glow.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You won't be able to evade at this distance.
A flash starts to shine immediately in front of Rapi's face.
Right in that moment, Anis's palm snaps forward and snatches the flash, closing tightly around it.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I'll tell you what! Have a little Entertainment Punch!
Anis drives her light-filled fist straight into Endless's face.
*Thwack!*
A flash erupts from Endless's body as Anis's punch lands.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I think I'm starting to get how to use this thing!
As Endless staggers, Neon's gunfire follows.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: This one's gonna hit harder!
Neon's gun ramps up, and then...
*Boooom!*
A shock wave powerful enough to shake the ground erupts from Neon's weapon.
Endless is blasted backwards, hurtling through a building before finally coming to a stop.
Staggering to her feet, Endless looks with utter shock at the hole in her abdomen.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You damaged this body...?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Nice shot, Neon.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Nice punch, Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Nice drill, Rapi.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I've decided I shall play with you until I'm able to learn your patterns and specifications.
*Krrrkrrrkrrrk*
The cavity in her abdomen seals itself.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: This body can repair itself, meaning I can continue with this indefinitely.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It can repair itself...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, right. They could do that.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wait, but does that mean...?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Yes. While not at the level of a Heretic,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Endless's body is equipped with nanomachine-based self-repair technology.
Rapi, Anis, and Neon all turn to look at me.
I meet their gaze and bite down on my wrist.
Nanomachines, you say.
